Condo Window Tinting
Is window tinting worth it for a condo?

Yes — high-rise condos live behind floor-to-ceiling and balcony glass with no shade, so an unfilmed unit gets very hot by mid-afternoon and the A/C never stops. Quality film cuts that heat by up to 10°C, saves 20–30% on your electricity bill, kills glare on TVs and screens, and adds daytime privacy from neighbouring towers — all while keeping the city view crystal clear.
How much does condo window tinting cost in Thailand?

Installed film runs from ฿70/sq ft for carbon film up to ฿180/sq ft for premium sputtering. Most condo units fall between ฿8,000 and ฿30,000, depending on total glass area, ceiling height and film tier. The exact figure is confirmed free during your on-site measurement.
Can you see through condo window film at night?

Daytime-privacy film works by reflecting the brighter side. In daylight, people in neighbouring towers can't see in while you keep your city view. At night — when interior lights are on and it's darker outside — that reverses, so for bedrooms we recommend pairing film with curtains or blinds, or choosing a higher-privacy tier. We advise the right film per room during measurement.
How effective is condo window film against heat?

Premium ceramic and sputtering films reject the majority of heat and 99% of UV, lowering indoor temperatures by up to 10°C and cutting A/C load 20–30%. On a west-facing high-rise unit with full-height glass and no shade, that is a significant, measurable drop in your monthly electricity bill.
Is JaiDeeClear film approved for condos and managed buildings?

Yes. Many condos require your building management to approve any film so the tower keeps a uniform exterior look. We offer building-approved, neutral-looking films and can supply the specs and samples your management needs. We install inside your unit on-site, with no glass removed and no disruption to the building.
Do you install condo window film on-site across Thailand?

Yes. JaiDeeClear is a fully mobile service — certified technicians come to your condo in Phuket, Bangkok, Chonburi and beyond. Most units are filmed in a few hours, with no glass removed. Free on-site measurement is included with every quote.
